propositions: Core modules outbound_comments.py and inbound_translate.py unconditionally load Jira-specific rich-text and comment-limit modules by literal lazy-key strings regardless of configured backend, causing vendor code execution on neutral paths.

Literal lazy-load keys 'rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira.adf' and 'rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira.comment_limits' in outbound_comments.py must be deleted and replaced with backend-polymorphic port role method calls.
Literal lazy-load key '_ADF_KEY_APPLIER' in inbound_translate.py must be deleted and replaced with InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text routed through the configured backend.

FieldSanitizer port role must gain a new method fit_comment(body: str) -> str for pure fit-to-limit operations on the comment-diff path, delegating to comment_limits.truncate_comment_body without send-side warnings.

InboundMapper port role must gain normalize_rich_text(body: Any) -> str to decode vendor-specific rich-text formats (Jira: adf_to_text for dicts, identity for strings) and serve both inbound apply and outbound comment-diff normalization.

A backend-neutrality sweep gate test must verify no package-root core module contains 'rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira' literal string except for recorded inbound_fields.py exemption, with rationale and follow-up ticket documented.
